title: Compatible isomorphisms of adic quotients induce an isomorphism of completions
statement: Let (A,I) and (B,J) be rings with ideals, and let e_n:A/I^n \to B/J^n be ring isomorphisms for n\geq1 that commute with all quotient transition maps. Then the induced map on inverse limits lim_n A/I^n \to lim_n B/J^n is a ring isomorphism. It is the unique map whose composite with every quotient projection is e_n. Completion means the adic completion of [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].
